pages.title: Frost Ward Torch
pages.text: A torch infused with the frozen breath of a $(l:threats/hollow)Hollow$(/l). Emits a piercing cold light (level 15) and snowflake particles.$(br2)$(bold)Primary function:$() Hollows flee at a 16-block radius — fast. Like "creeper-saw-a-cat" fast. Normal torches only deter them at close range via light; the Frost Ward Torch specifically repels them.$(br2)Place these around your base perimeter. Sleep easier knowing the whispering smoke things can't get in.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Engineering Note: We cannot explain why burning a ghost's own breath on a stick repels it. The working theory is "spite."$()
Frozen Breath over a Stick. Yields 4. The recipe is simple. Acquiring the Frozen Breath is the hard part, on account of the ghost.
